description: Create a new chunking, structural or grid profile. `profile` holds that kind's fields. chunking: name, prompt (must contain {{pre_chunk}}), overlap_ratio, max_signature_len, metadata_fields (JSON text), match_strategy (exact_forward|fuzzy), fuzzy_threshold. structural: name, min_chunk_chars, max_chunk_chars, patterns[{group_name, role, regex, flags, priority, label, sort_order}]. grid (a template = prompt + answer columns): name, system_prompt (the template's prompt, asked of every row), data_format (plain|json), json_schema ({mode: object|array, fields: [{key, type: string|number|integer|boolean|date|enum, description, enum_values?, optional?}]}). Returns the stored profile.

profile.description: The new profile's fields (see tool description).

name: create_profile
